instructions_to_main_agent: Use React Native Expo. Build mobile-first. Rely on React Native StyleSheet for styling using the provided design tokens. Use expo-linear-gradient for the Floo Money Card. Implement react-native-reanimated for shimmer, progress, and success animations. Apply precise 8pt grid spacing and premium typography. ALWAYS include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, list items) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., login-submit-button). Do NOT use HTML tags (use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, etc.). Do NOT use Inter or Roboto, use the provided Plus Jakarta Sans font family. Emphasize touch targets of 48px+.

Input.rules: Include inline validation icon (Check in green) on the right when input is valid.

FlooMoneyCard.rules: Use expo-linear-gradient with tokens.colors.gradients.floo_money. Include white text, chip icon/logo, and highly visible balance. Display premium bank card look.

Onboarding.flow: 4 steps with visual progress indicator (dots or lines). Clean modern illustrations. Final step has 'Commencer' primary button.

Authentication.login: Email/Phone input, Password. Prominent GREEN biometric login button explicitly placed under 'Se connecter'. Forgot password link (10 min validity text).
Authentication.signup: Email + Phone, inline verification with 3 min countdown. 6-digit OTP input. PIN creation (6 digits).

HomeDashboard.layout: Top header with user name, Avatar, and notifications. Prominent Floo Money Card below header. Quick services grid (Transfer, Wallet, Scan, etc.). Recent transactions list with Status chips.

steps: 4. Success: Show generated 10-digit code and HMAC-SHA256 signed QR Code. Play success animation.

AuctionScreen.layout: Real-time UI for agent bids. 90-second countdown timer at top (progress circle or animated bar). List of AgentBidCard updating dynamically. WebSocket connected state indicator.

Wallet.layout: Floo Money balance header. Large buttons for QR code top-up and withdrawal options. Section for P2P free transfers.

KYC.layout: Tier 1 & Tier 2 limits display. Didit WebView integration entry point. Showcase user badges (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum) clearly.
